propositions: Every supported Cloud/DC mutation must route through exactly one typed coordinator/adapter path with no generic `_call_with_retry`, `_best_effort`, or duck-typed fallback reachable in production.
Unsupported production actions must fail with a typed provider-neutral error before any local or remote effects occur.

The `binding_store.repair_at_write_boundary()` call in `reconcile.py` must execute after the under-lock staleness validation and before the first remote issue fetch to preserve repair-ordering semantics.
Cursor, baseline, and binding state must advance only after proven postconditions; deferred, failed, skipped, and commit-unknown work must remain recoverable and never reported as applied.

Preview, manifest, and logs must preserve existing mutation fields and add versioned redacted sections for lifecycle, logical/physical attempts, delay/budget, disposition, fuse, and `retry_not_before` data.
